author: Rob Loach
install_msg: Retro installed. Load it with `[p]load retro`, then attach a ROM to `[p]retro` and play. The emulators download in the background on first load, so give them a minute.
name: Retro
short: Play retro console games in Discord
description:
Play retro console games together in Discord, emulated with libretro.

Start a game by name, URL or an attached ROM and control it with buttons under the screen. Every press posts a clip of the next second and a half of play. Nine consoles, from the NES to the Game Boy Advance. Games save themselves and resume where they left off; Undo steps back eight presses.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per channel: the channel and message ID of each game, the name of the game, the ID of the member who started it, and a copy of the ROM with its save state and in-game save. The member ID is the only personal data, and it goes when the record does. Records are deleted automatically once they can no longer resume anything -- when the channel is deleted, the bot leaves the server, or the cached ROM is cleaned up. Saves are kept until somebody deletes them with `[p]retrosaves delete`, which the game's starter, anyone with Manage Messages, and the bot owner can do. The clip is an attachment on the game's message and is stored nowhere else; the presser's display name appears in that message as plain text and is not stored. Nothing is shared with anyone.
